name: smwsprites-cluster-effects-pack
title: Cluster Effects Pack
description:
Special effects to be inserted as cluster sprites, to spice up any level. Included are falling leaves, rain, fish, and sandstorm. See the readme for more info.

Update 3/29/2020: This now comes with .json files and I added to cluster folder to insert easily.

Update 4/12/2022: Restored old readme and archive structure, made the spawner use extra byte (effectively merging all jsons) and provided an alternative uberASM version.
